economicMechanism: Executives and major shareholders trade with private information about long-horizon firm value. Open-market purchases are discretionary and costly (they are also disclosed, so they carry signalling cost), unlike grants, option exercises, inheritance or gifts, which are excluded. Reported purchases are a slow-moving, sparsely covered disclosure in a large-cap universe dominated by owner-managers, so if the market under-reacts the drift should accumulate over 6-12 months rather than days. This is a candidate mechanism, not a finding: published evidence is concentrated in US small caps and may be weaker in a top-120 universe.

information.source: DART list.json (pblntf_ty=D, report_nm contains '임원ㆍ주요주주특정증권등소유상황보고서', originals only; amendments recorded but excluded) + document.xml original filing
information.fields: per detail row: RPT_RSN label (+raw code), MDF_DM date, STR_KND label, MDF_STK_CNT signed shares, ACI_AMT2 price
information.openMarket: reason label exactly '장내매수(+)' (buy) or '장내매도(-)' (sell) AND security label exactly '보통주'; every other row is recorded and never counted
information.pointInTime: usable at the close of the first KRX session strictly after the DART receipt date
information.structuredEndpointNote: elestock.json is NOT used: measured 2026-11-03 it serves only ~2 years (Samsung Electronics: 3,368 rows, 2024-11-11..2026-11-03)

universe: PIT KRX Top-120 common shares on each anchor (the repository's ledger/universe/kr snapshots); preferred shares excluded
anchors: the 155 21-session anchors of the replay calendar (signal dates 2013-01-04 .. 2026-08-07), the same schedule as the saved C2 path

state.definition: net open-market common shares across all reporting insiders of the issuer, over original filings AVAILABLE in the 63 KRX sessions ending on the anchor

labels.basis: shareholder total return from the next KRX session close after the anchor, per the existing KR label engine and the alpha-opportunity-model-v4 label-eligibility contract (a name whose dividend/terminal basis is unresolved is label-INELIGIBLE and leaves BOTH baskets' denominators)
labels.benchmark: 069500.KS Phase C reconciled gross total return (economic comparison only)

primaryStatistic.perAnchor: S_t = equal-weight mean label of NET_BUYER minus equal-weight mean label of NO_OPEN_MARKET_TRADE, eligible names only; anchors with < 5 buyers or < 20 controls give no S_t (counted)
primaryStatistic.aggregate: mean of S_t over anchors with a value
primaryStatistic.inference: Bartlett Newey-West over anchors, lag 5 (H126) and 11 (H252); two-sided 97.5% interval per horizon (Bonferroni over the two primary claims)
primaryStatistic.independence: about 25 non-overlapping H126 and 12 non-overlapping H252 windows; overlapping anchors are not independent trials

economics.portfolio: long-only equal-weight NET_BUYER basket rebalanced every anchor, held to the next anchor (21 sessions), compounded; compared with 069500.KS
economics.costs: weekly_decision.trade_cost_fraction('KR', date, side, is_benchmark=False) at 1x, 2x, 3x on one-way turnover
economics.reported: CAGR, H126/H252 window distributions, MDD (block-end), one-way turnover (names replaced vs retargeted), cost drag, arithmetic vs Jensen split

powerAndEffectSize.rule: MDE = (z_0.9875 + z_0.80) * sigma_S / sqrt(N_eff) = 3.08 * sigma_S / sqrt(N_eff); with N_eff ~ 25 (H126) the detectable mean spread is ~0.62 sigma_S, with N_eff ~ 12 (H252) ~0.89 sigma_S
powerAndEffectSize.sigmaSource: sigma_S is the time-series SD of S_t and is NOT estimated here (that would read outcomes); a result whose interval is wider than the economically relevant spread (3pp per H126) is reported as UNDERPOWERED_NOT_NEGATIVE
powerAndEffectSize.densityGate: before any label: at least 60% of anchors must have >= 5 NET_BUYER and >= 20 NO_OPEN_MARKET_TRADE names, from filings alone

decisionRule.SOURCE_BLOCKED: parse failure on > 5% of original insider filings in the collection, or receipt-date coverage gaps in any calendar year
decisionRule.POWER_BLOCKED: density gate fails (measured before any label)
decisionRule.INSIDER_SPREAD_SUPPORTED: both a 97.5% lower bound > 0 for the H126 spread AND the long-only basket's net excess over 069500.KS > 0 at 2x cost; H252 reported with its own interval
decisionRule.NO_EVIDENCE: H126 interval contains zero (H252 cannot rescue it)
decisionRule.UNDERPOWERED_NOT_NEGATIVE: interval contains zero and is wider than +/-3pp

noRescue: No change after outcomes to the 63-session window, the >0 threshold, the reason labels, the universe, the anchors, the horizons, the cost model, the baskets' minimum sizes or the period. A failed result is reported and the study closes; a different definition is a new registration.
evidenceClassIfExecuted: EXPLORATORY_DEVELOPMENT_ON_OUTCOME_EXPOSED_KR_PRICES_WITH_NEVER_TESTED_INFORMATION; a supported result requires prospective receipts before any production use
productionImpact: none; the KR default stays 069500.KS 100% and 0-5 names are shown only with an admitted validated signal
